question_text: Three large closed rooms X, Y and Z are at temperatures 35$^\circ$C, 25$^\circ$C and 20$^\circ$C respectively. Assume that all the rooms are saturated with water vapour. Consider the following statements:

options.option_text: If the person enters the room X, initially some of the sweat will begin to evaporate.
If the person enters the room Z, initially some of the sweat will begin to evaporate.
If the person enters the room Y, initially some of the sweat will begin to evaporate.
only B and C are true.
only A and B are true.
